source.title: Bird - Red-shouldered hawk
source.author: Vrymaa
source.notes: 48 kHz mono, 10 s, a bird sanctuary: a red-shouldered hawk's cry, two series of about 4.3 s at 2.4-2.6 kHz, 71 dB over a near-silent background. They join kvgarlic's red_shouldered_hawk (credited), whose file is left as it is.
